Scenario/Locations/Abandoned-Cobalt-Mine.title: Abandoned Cobalt Mine
Scenario/Locations/Abandoned-Cobalt-Mine.content:
Description 
                  
                

An old cobalt mine located near the trading town of Dashbalar. Due to increasing offworld imports and decreasing ore  yields, it was abandoned a few cycles ago. Rumours speak of much larger deposits remaining at greater depths, and with the price of the mineral rising again, due to price-gouging from Imperial merchants, the local population has considered re-opening the mine. This currently seems unlikely, however, as bandits from Tormudai Fortress appear to have occupied the mine since.



Ideas
Plot

Old cobalt mine, has more untapped cobalt further down.
Currently occupied by bandits. Player has to wipe them out in order to access the cobalt.
That could then set off more bandit attacks for a while, encourage player to engage Tormudai Fortress to reduce them again immediately / solve the problem “once and for all”.

Build

Custom voxelmap for the top? would allow for some interesting terrain like a mine shaft
Crane into the mine shaft?
Mix of civilian-style buildings with bandit stuff on top / alongside
